headline: President Bush creates a task force to study ways to improve how health care is delivered to the nation's veterans.
what_it_does: This executive order sets up a presidential task force focused on veterans' health care. Based on the title, the group's job is to look for ways to improve how health care services reach veterans. No summary was provided, so details on members, specific duties, and deadlines are not covered here.

who_it_affects.group: Veterans who use government health care
who_it_affects.how: The task force is meant to look for ways to improve how their health care is delivered.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that provide veterans' health care
who_it_affects.how: Their health care delivery is the subject the task force is set up to review.
